title: chtypes v1 lock file (schema 3)
description: chtypes.lock (docs/guides/fetch-v1.md §6): per declared platform, the request, the exact version and build, and the platform manifest/layer/bundle digests. The index digest is informational only (never fetched by digest under --frozen; §7.4 of the layout-v2 spec). Schema 1 and 2 (v0) are refused outright, never read as this shape.

requests.description: Keyed by the spelling originally requested (e.g. "26.8", "26.8.15", "26.8.15.10").

additionalProperties.description: Keyed by platform key; only platforms this lock declares (the `platforms` array) may appear.

version.description: The exact four-part version resolved at lock time, e.g. "26.8.15.10".

build.description: The fixed-width UTC build timestamp from the signed predicate, e.g. "20261001.183455".

index.description: Informational only. The index is computed, not stored, so a by-digest GET of it is not guaranteed to be served; --frozen never fetches it.
